P01E01.title: Muddy Puddles
P01E01.hook: 下雨天不能出门，雨一停 Peppa 和 George 就冲进花园，跳进一个又一个泥坑。

cells.a: It was rainy. They could not play outside.
cells.cn: 那天下雨，他们不能在外面玩。

cells.a: She asked, “Can we go out to play?”
cells.cn: 她问爸爸能不能出去玩。

cells.a: She loved jumping in muddy puddles.
cells.cn: 她最爱在泥坑里跳。

cells.a: She said, “You must wear your boots.”
cells.cn: 妈妈说：“你必须穿上雨靴。”

cells.a: She looked after her little brother, George.
cells.cn: 她照顾弟弟 George。

cells.q: What did Peppa find in the garden?
cells.a: She found a really big puddle.
cells.cn: 她在花园里找到一个超大的泥坑。

cells.a: She checked if the puddle was safe for George.
cells.cn: 她先确认这个泥坑对弟弟安不安全。

cells.a: He guessed they jumped in muddy puddles.
cells.cn: 爸爸猜到他们去跳泥坑了。

cells.q: What did the whole family do at last?
cells.a: They all jumped in muddy puddles.
cells.cn: 最后一家人都跳进了泥坑。

helper.keywords: rain, puddle, muddy, boots, garden, safe
helper.actions: jump, splash, check, wear, look after

P01E02.title: Mr Dinosaur Is Lost
P01E02.hook: George 最爱的玩具恐龙先生不见了，Peppa 第一次当侦探，要把它找回来。

cells.a: It was Mr. Dinosaur.
cells.cn: 是恐龙先生。

cells.q: What did George like to do?
cells.a: He liked to scare Peppa with Mr. Dinosaur.
cells.cn: 他喜欢用恐龙先生吓 Peppa。

cells.q: Where did Mr. Dinosaur sit at suppertime?
cells.a: It sat next to George.
cells.cn: 它坐在 George 旁边。

cells.q: Did George take Mr. Dinosaur to the bath?
cells.a: Yes. He shared his bath with him.
cells.cn: 是的，他和恐龙先生一起洗澡。

cells.a: He threw Mr. Dinosaur up in the air.
cells.cn: 他把恐龙先生往天上扔。

cells.a: He was sad and cried. He lost Mr. Dinosaur.
cells.cn: 他很难过，哭了起来——恐龙先生丢了。

cells.a: Peppa was. She said, “I will help you find him.”
cells.cn: 是 Peppa。她说要帮弟弟找到它。

cells.q: Was Mr. Dinosaur in the bath?
cells.a: No. He was not in the bath.
cells.cn: 不在，浴缸里没有他。

cells.q: Where did they find Mr. Dinosaur?
cells.a: They found him high up in the tree.
cells.cn: 他们发现他高高地挂在树上。

helper.actions: throw, catch, scare, cry, guess, find

P01E03.title: Best Friend
P01E03.hook: 好朋友 Suzy 来家里玩，George 想加入却被赶出去，最后他成了游戏里最重要的病人。

cells.a: She was waiting for her best friend, Suzy Sheep.
cells.cn: 她在等最好的朋友小羊 Suzy。

cells.a: Yes. Peppa loved Suzy, and Suzy loved Peppa.
cells.cn: 是的，她们互相喜欢。

cells.a: She said, “Go and play in your bedroom.”
cells.cn: 妈妈说：“去卧室里玩吧。”

cells.a: No. She said the game was just for big girls.
cells.cn: 没有。她说这个游戏只有大女孩能玩。

cells.q: What did Peppa pretend to be?
cells.a: She pretended to be a fairy princess.
cells.cn: 她假装自己是仙女公主。

cells.a: He felt a bit lonely.
cells.cn: 他觉得有点孤单。

cells.a: She was making chocolate chip cookies.
cells.cn: 她在做巧克力豆饼干。

cells.a: They played doctors and nurses with George.
cells.cn: 他们拉着 George 玩医生和护士。

cells.a: He had a sore tummy, so he wanted cookies.
cells.cn: 他肚子疼，所以也想吃饼干。

helper.actions: play, wave, help, pretend, share, eat
